type Labels = Readonly<[string, ...number[]]>;
const labels: Labels = ["total", 1, 2];
console.log(labels[1].toFixed(1), labels.length);

type Draft = Partial<[number, ...string[]]>;
const draft: Draft = [1, "a", undefined];
console.log(draft.map((item) => item ?? "none").join(","));

type Boxed<T> = { [K in keyof T]: { value: T[K] } };
const row: Boxed<[string, ...number[], boolean]> = [{ value: "id" }, { value: 2 }, { value: 3 }, { value: true }];
const middle = row[1] as { value: number };
console.log(middle.value.toFixed(2));

function freeze<U extends unknown[]>(items: Readonly<[string, ...U]>): Readonly<[string, ...U]> {
  return items;
}
const frozen = freeze(["head", 1, true]);
const second: number = frozen[1];
const third: boolean = frozen[2];
console.log(second + 1, third);

function boxAll<T extends unknown[]>(items: T): Boxed<T> {
  return items.map((value) => ({ value })) as unknown as Boxed<T>;
}
const boxed = boxAll<[string, ...number[]]>(["a", 1, 2]);
console.log(boxed.length, boxed[0].value.toUpperCase());
